patterns.note: Full-width hero section featuring a large background image with a dark overlay, centered headline, and a prominent search bar.
Responsive grid system for property listings, typically displaying four columns on larger screens with consistent card sizing and information hierarchy.
The main navigation and hero search bar transform from a transparent, larger state over the hero image to a compact, opaque sticky header with a background as the user scrolls down.
A clean palette dominated by white backgrounds, contrasted with dark text and vibrant blue accents for interactive elements and calls to action.
Feature sections often use large, aspirational imagery with content blocks overlaid or presented as a three-column card layout for articles and promotions.

technique_notes: The primary navigation and search interface dynamically adjust their size and position, transitioning from an initial transparent overlay on the hero to a fixed, opaque bar at the top of the viewport upon scroll.
Content cards for listings and features utilize subtle corner rounding and consistent internal padding, creating a clean and organized presentation within grid layouts.
Call-to-action buttons are designed with solid blue backgrounds and white text, providing clear visual hierarchy and consistent interaction points across the site.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are clear and distinct from body text, with a moderate size difference; hero text is significantly larger and lighter weight for visual impact.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards, buttons, and input fields, providing a soft, approachable feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a consistent grid rhythm for content cards, creating an airy yet structured layout.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dynamic transformation of the hero search bar. It seamlessly shrinks and integrates into a sticky header upon scroll, making the core search functionality persistently accessible without cluttering the initial hero view.
